image_description: A vintage advertisement featuring a meat cleaver with a wooden handle and a large rectangular steel blade. A sliced tomato rests on the blade, and Hunt's tomato products are visible in the bottom left corner. Text at the top reads 'Hunt's. Made from the meat of the tomato.'

artifact_observations.reasoning: The small paragraph of text in the bottom-left corner exhibits slight character merging and irregular kerning, typical of AI-generated text or low-resolution OCR artifacts in synthetic images, though the main headline is crisp.
The internal structure of the sliced tomato is slightly smudged and lacks the distinct definition of individual seed pockets, appearing somewhat 'painted' rather than photorealistic.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is taxonomically a cleaver and not a generic knife or spatula.
To rigorously check the legibility and correctness of the headline and body text, as text artifacts are present.
To ensure the handle is physically connected to the blade without melting or floating artifacts.
To assess the realism of the organic matter (tomato) which shows potential texture anomalies.

focus_areas: Text legibility and character consistency in the ad copy
Structural integrity of the handle-to-blade connection (rivets)
Realism of the tomato texture and lighting reflections on the steel
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text in the bottom left. While the main headline is clear, AI often fails at small body text. Also, verify if the tomato looks like a real cross-section or a stylized drawing, as this affects the 'photorealism' score even if the cleaver itself is perfect.
